title: Agents hand back a short JSON beside the 10 lines
what: Each agent hand-back also carries a short JSON beside the 10-line text (status, report path, commits), and a hook checks it, so the session reads the fields instead of the prose.
why: The coordinating session decides from hand-backs; reading prose for the status and the report path is the label search the structured-data rule forbids.
dropped_why: "We should store only structured data that can be splitted into repeated domain data, if this unstructured instructions or plain text - you don't need to store it in structured format"; then "a": reword rules/structured-data.md and drop the feature structured-hand-backs.
